mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.phone_num, g.description, g.address, g.file, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) AS rating, COUNT(r.review_num) AS review_count FROM GYM g LEFT JOIN REVIEW_GYM r ON g.id = r.gym_id WHERE g.id = #{value} GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.phone_num, g.description, g.address, g.file
